title: Our path
subtitle: From parsing one invoice to a routing platform for business documents

stages.title: Invoice fields
stages.summary: PDFs and scans become number, date, supplier, total and VAT with a confidence score.
stages.decision: Read the whole document through a profile, not line by line: context is cheaper than a confident error.

stages.title: Human review
stages.summary: Fields are editable; Confirm records the decision and the review time.
stages.decision: A confident error is worse than a gap, so the person stays in the loop.

stages.title: First CRM: Uspacy
stages.summary: A confirmed invoice creates a real deal in a real account.
stages.decision: One full path to the CRM first, breadth afterwards.

stages.title: Duplicate protection
stages.summary: The same invoice never creates a second deal.
stages.decision: Two checkpoints: our own history and the CRM data itself.

stages.title: Review queue
stages.summary: Unconfirmed documents wait in Needs attention and survive a page reload.
stages.decision: A process must tolerate pauses instead of demanding constant attention.

stages.title: Supplier card and contact
stages.summary: Company gets phone, address, tax ID, bank and IBAN; the contact is linked to the deal.
stages.decision: A deal without requisites is half the job; the integration must deliver a card, not a row.

stages.title: Second document type: act
stages.summary: The title decides the type; an act has its own reading rules and its own deal name.
stages.decision: Do not grow one parser: plug in a registry of document profiles.

stages.title: Folder intake
stages.summary: A file dropped into the folder shows up in the queue by itself.
stages.decision: Documents arrive on their own, so intake must not depend on a manual upload.

stages.title: Second CRM: Bitrix24
stages.summary: Connector and local emulator are ready; a live portal needs the client's incoming webhook.
stages.decision: Every CRM behind one interface: the client must not be locked to a vendor.

stages.title: Contracts and delivery notes
stages.summary: Third and fourth document types on the same profile registry.
stages.decision: The next breadth step is new types, not perfection of one.

stages.title: Email and external sources
stages.summary: Invoices arrive by email or through the customer's API, not only from a folder.
stages.decision: A platform starts where the intake is not a single source.

stages.title: Document routing
stages.summary: An invoice goes to payments, an act to accounting, a large amount to approval; the route and its reason are recorded.
stages.decision: A route nobody can explain is a route nobody trusts: every destination carries its reason.

stages.title: Roles and audit
stages.summary: Who uploaded, who confirmed, what changed — for a real department.
stages.decision: Responsibility in the process must be visible, not implied.

stages.title: Routing rules per supplier and several recipients
stages.summary: Rules by company or supplier, and one document can notify several destinations.
stages.decision: Real departments route by counterparty, not only by document type.
